final_message:
Configured the requested host names and MX records, with all 40 PCs pointing to the lab resolver at pc34 (`10.15.9.12`).

The DNS hierarchy uses pc1 as the root; pc2–pc5 for `com`, `net`, `edu`, and `it`; and pc6, pc8–pc10, pc12–pc15, pc21, pc32, and pc33 for the child zones. Those DNS PCs and pc34 now use the BIND image; their configuration files and startup commands were added without changing the network connections.

I assumed an IPv4-only, isolated DNS hierarchy. Static configuration checks passed, but BIND validation tools were unavailable, and the lab was not run, so live resolution remains to be verified.
